The launch environment each fixture was compiled under. The symbolic strides in the ttir (%sam, %sak, ...) resolve to these at selection time. Declared here, not guessed at the call site: a different launch is a different program.

The strides are the PHYSICAL strides of contiguous (M,K), (K,N), (M,N) tensors: A's k-stride is K=64, B's k-stride is N=128 (NOT the K-loop bound — this file previously said 64, which addresses the wrong rows and computes garbage; found by executing the kernel on a real GPU against fp64), C's m-stride is N=128. Alignment 4 holds for every value. Every constraint of both ISAs is still satisfied by these values (MAC16 needs stride[1]==1 and m,n%16==0; DMA2D needs shape[0]%4==0 and stride[0]%4==0), so selection is unchanged by the correction — verified: the selector table reproduces identically before and after.
